subject: distsamp + random effect for space and time

messages.subject: distsamp + random effect for space and time
parts:
Dear all, 

I hope I reach you well and with some patience for statistic beginners. 

I am trying to model the density of a butterfly species in a light forest area and I would like to explain the density with a bunch of habitat parameters that mainly represent the successional stage of the forest to understand the spatiotemporal variation and abundance of the butterfly species.

I have a dataset of 

  • 1 butterfly species that was recorded using distance sampling on a line transect with 4 distance classes 

  • In 2 consecutive years 

  • With each 5 repetitions to cover the main flight time 

  • In two different counties / 19 different regions.

  • Each year had around 80 sites out of which 40 were repeated  in both years but varied in successional stage 

  • Habitat parameters (e.g. tree cover, grass cover, host plant cover) for each site for both years

Is it possible to use the function “distsamp” from the “unmarked” package and year and counties(or region) as random effects? Or do I have to  model the density with unmarked and then use these as response variable in a GLMM (lme4) or GAM (mgcv)? How do I deal with violation of independence between the 40 repeated sites?

I hope I can find help here. 
Best wishes, 
Rebecca
